items.title: Commonwealth says it will block gas-fired data centres

children.content: The NT government has rejected a federal plan to mandate the use of renewables for new large-scale data centres, but the Commonwealth says it will block proposals that rely on gas.

children.content: Authorities say a crash on the Stuart Highway, which claimed the lives of everyone involved, "appears to have been a high-speed head-on collision" that caused both vehicles to catch fire.

items.title: Murder accused to remain in custody as lawyers struggle to find suitable bail location
